title: Shake Down Cruise

organizer.name: Xelseor Mission Protocol Sim Crew Meetups

description:
Your Starship Needs You! A Live Multiplayer Starship Simulation

Tuesday, November 17, 2026 | Online | Free Event | 2–3 Hours

Ever wanted to serve aboard a starship? Now’s your chance!

Welcome aboard the Xelseor Mission Protocol Simulator, an immersive, cooperative starship simulation where YOU become part of the crew!

This isn’t a presentation or a demonstration. You’ll join other participants aboard a virtual starship, take responsibility for an assigned crew station, and work together to complete a mission.

For the next 2–3 hours, your decisions, communication, and teamwork will help determine the outcome.

What’s Your Assignment?

Every starship needs a capable crew, and everyone has a role to play!

Depending on your assignment, you might find yourself:

* At the Helm: Piloting the starship, navigating through space, and executing maneuvers.
* In Engineering: Managing reactor power, propulsion, cooling, and critical ship systems.
* At Tactical: Operating defensive systems, tracking threats, and preparing weapons.
* At Science: Scanning unknown objects, investigating anomalies, and gathering mission-critical intelligence.
* In Command: Coordinating the crew, making strategic decisions, and directing the mission.

You’ll be assigned a station as part of a crew, with real responsibilities throughout the simulation.

How Does It Work?

1. Sign Up: Reserve your place in our upcoming simulation.
1. Receive Your Assignment: You’ll be assigned a crew position aboard one of our starships.
1. Report for Duty: Join us online for your scheduled mission.
1. Complete the Mission: Work alongside your fellow officers to overcome challenges and accomplish your objectives.

New Recruits Welcome!

Never operated a starship before? No problem!

You don’t need prior simulator experience or specialized knowledge. Whether you’re a science-fiction enthusiast, a cooperative gamer, or just someone looking for a unique online experience, you’re welcome aboard.

The goal is to have fun, work together, and experience what it’s like to be part of a functioning starship crew.

Explore Your Future Station

Want to familiarize yourself with the ship before reporting for duty?

Explore our interactive console demos:

https://johnnydevcraft.github.io/ShipSimDemo

Take a look around, explore the controls, and start thinking about which station you’d enjoy operating.

Ready to Report for Duty?

This is a free, online, interactive event, and every participant will have an assigned role in the simulation.

Bring your curiosity, your enthusiasm, and your willingness to work as a team.

The mission is waiting. The crew is assembling. All we need is you.

Welcome aboard, Officer.
